_comment: Hand-painted island set-dressing. Each TYPE has `variants` painted versions (type_01..type_NN); WorldGen scatters a seed-chosen subset per player so no two islands look alike. Loaded from art/decorations/<type>_<nn>.png. `material` drives how it spawns + idles: plant (sprouts up + sways), fungus (bobs/breathes), crystal (shimmers), light (flickers/floats), stone (settles, heavy), wood (slow creak), water (ripple bob).
